LESSON: HEALING OF

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The life 3.4 Miraculous catch By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to re
Topic 3.5: Healing of

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Healing of. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate Jesus’ compassion by expressing kindness to others and recite it aloud in front of the class

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate Jesus’ compassion by expressing kindness to others and recite it aloud in front of the class
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate Jesus’ compassion by expressing kindness to others and recite it aloud in front of the class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Healing of.
2. Explain Healing of to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Healing of.
4. Show that you can: appreciate Jesus’ compassion by expressing kindness to others and recite it aloud in front of the class
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing of. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Healing of important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate Jesus’ compassion by expressing kindness to others and recite it aloud in front of the class

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
